QuestInfo.name: The Maple Administrator's Congratulations
QuestInfo.0: When you reach Lvl. 20, the #p9010000# starts talking to you...
QuestInfo.1: The Maple Administrator congratulates you for reaching Lvl. 20 and casts the Dragon's Blessing on you. According to her, #p9010010# is also very excited about the growth of the Dragon Master... #bShe says that you can receive a gift from #b#p9010010##k by reaching #bLv. 30#k by May 5.
